title: Onboard paladin-13b-v1.0: performance profiles, metadata, and changelog automation
author: Aisha Patel
description: Adds the Paladin-13B v1.0 model to the model registry with curated performance profiles, canonical metadata, and automated changelog entry generation. Motivation: Paladin-13B is a high-throughput open model that our partners requested for mid-latency production workloads; onboarding enables internal teams to route traffic and run perf comparisons. Changes include: (1) model metadata manifest (sha256, config, tokenizer info, recommended quantization profiles), (2) auto-generated performance profiles for common sequence lengths and batch sizes (latency P50/P95, throughput), (3) changelog automation hook that creates a release note entry when a model version is merged, and (4) lightweight validation harness and example workload for the perf lab. Checklist: - [x] metadata manifest validated against schema - [x] perf profiles generated and smoke-tested on n1-gpu CI runner - [x] changelog automation integrated with registry CI - [x] docs snippet updated (model catalog) - [x] security scan passed (no secret leakage). Testing notes: perf profiles were created using the perf-canary harness with 3 warmup runs and 10 measured runs across 1/2/4 batch sizes; latency and throughput values are recorded in the profile and uploaded to the model-metrics bucket. The autoscript that generates the changelog entry is idempotent and writes a draft file under /changelogs/paladin/ which the release tooling consumes. Rollout plan: merged to main, will be available in the next registry refresh; we will enable serving in staged Dedicated pool and monitor cost/latency for 48 hours before promoting to general availability. Related: ENG-4827 covers performance validation, PM-134 tracks catalog listing copy.
